startupBehavior: If no save can be loaded, try content/worldgen/packs/worldgen_home_island_v0_4.json.
If the worldgen pack cannot load, fall back to procedural GameWorld::starter().
knownLimitations: PlacedObject is still single-anchor only; multi-tile collision footprints remain data-side until the next runtime collision patch.
Object art is still rendered by existing runtime primitives unless atlas rendering is wired later.
migrationBehavior: Legacy 48x32 scene maps are centered into the 96x64 runtime scene.
Tiles, heights, zones, objects, stamps, spawns, autotile overrides, and transitions receive the same deterministic offset.
